newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Soy shipping conditions at key Brazilian ports.
newsitem.headline: Soy shipping conditions at key Brazilian ports.

text.p: The Brazilian ports of Paranagua and Santos reported the following conditions for shipping soybeans and soy products:
Vessels: Espris P loading 50,000 tonnes soybeans. Flag Leader loading 26,500 tonnes soymeal. Waiting to dock, none.
Road: 125 trucks carrying soybeans arrived between Aug 15 and 17, as well as 223 trucks with soymeal and 26 trucks with vegetable oils, including soyoil.

Vessels: Hermes loading 26,715 tonnes soymeal. Waiting to dock, one vessel to load 43,553 tonnes soybeans. No vessels docked at Cargill private terminal. Waiting to dock, one vessel to load 79,700 tonnes soymeal.
Road: Two trucks carrying 53 tonnes soybeans arrived on Aug 17.
Rail: 42 wagons arrived with 2,436 tonnes soybeans.
